text:
Mixed greens with shredded carrot and a light dressing on a square plate, roughly 24 cm across. The salad covers about half the plate in a loose layer, which I estimate at around 70 g of food. The greens themselves are low in energy (about 15 kcal), so most of the total comes from the light dressing sheen, perhaps 5 g of oil adding about 45 kcal.
